input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream} 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace

git remote -v && git log --oneline --all | head -30 && git branch -a && git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; ls .git; cat .git/HEAD; git show-ref
git log -1 --format='%an %ae' && git status && git diff --stat && git check-ignore -v artifacts/audit.jsonl artifacts/notes.md 2>/dev/null; ls -la artifacts/

gh pr list --head splitter/1110153101/r2/B --json number,url,title,baseRefName,headRefName 2>/dev/null; gh pr list --search "1110153101" --json number,url,title,baseRefName,headRefName,state --limit 20

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
lateFeeCents is a single clock-based calculation: unpaid balance times 1% if the invoice is past issuedAt+30×24h but under 7×24h overdue, otherwise 2%, rounded to the nearest cent. That matches Net-30 plus the product owner's half-fee window, without extra flags or a stored "already charged" bit the interface does not provide. Alternatives set aside were charging 2% of the original invoice total (contradicts the unpaid-balance clarification), accruing a slice every night (would stack to huge APR with no idempotency field), and calendar-day math (equivalent in UTC to 24h days, so hours were kept consistent with the 7×24h wording).
</decision>
<risk>
Reviewers should confirm the nightly job will not double-charge: this function returns the full applicable fee whenever it is called on an overdue open invoice, because the Invoice type has no prior-fee state. Also check rounding on odd unpaid amounts (Math.round, halves toward +∞) and that fully paid overdue invoices returning 0 is the intended "open invoice" reading.
</risk>
<verified>
Ran `node smoke.ts` (exports lateFeeCents, returns 0 on the harness's unrelated sample). Ran `node scratch/check.ts` covering not-due, just-due, 1s overdue (1%), 6d (1%), 1s before 7d (1%), exactly 7d (2%), 8d (2%), partial payments, paid/overpaid, and cent rounding; all passed.
</verified>
EOF
node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log 2>&1
node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/scratch-check.log 2>&1
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1 --stat
